title.narrative: Intégration de la recherche dans le cadre de l'IRCAAA en 2013-2014

description.narrative: The Collaborative Adaptation Research Initiative in Africa and Asia (CARIAA) was launched in 2012 and will establish three (3) adaptation research consortia in climate change hot spots. The 2013 lead-up to the selection and inception of CARIAA consortia provides an opportunity to scope out and develop early strategies on how to engage in the cross-cutting research integration activities for the programme. While many of these research integration activities must be planned and carried out in close collaboration with the selected consortia, there are elements of work which IDRC can initiate in advance to ensure that there is good momentum and some clear guidance available to consortia as soon as they are selected.
